title: Sania Mirza's Dubai Home Tour | Stories, Food and Rapid Fire | AAAP Ka Parivaar 2.0
description:
We spent a wonderful day with Sania Mirza at her beautiful Dubai home! From fun conversations and a rapid-fire round to hearing about the honours she has received, including the Arjuna Award, Khel Ratna, Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan, there was so much to talk about! It was a lovely day filled with laughter, stories, great food and some very special moments with Sania and her family.

Watch the full episode and get to know the tennis legend beyond the court.
